Xitaa haddii kala saaruhu yahay taban, waxaa jira kiiska xididdadu yihiin 1 + i iyo 1 (p = −(2 + i), q = 1 + i, p² − 4q = −1), sidaas darteed lama dejin.

Hubinta sadarka 4 waxay muujisaa oo keliya in x = 8 uu yahay xal mana aha in aan jirin xalal kale. Sidaas darteed "kan keliya" ee sadarka 5 waa khalad, xalalka dhabta ahna waa 2 iyo 8.
z-m-23-06.s.s2.prompt: Isle'egyada soo socda dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin isla qodob (x − 1) oo labada dhinac lagu dhuftay. Kee ayaan xal wax lumin marka lagu xalliyo labada dhinac oo lagu qaybiyo (x − 1)?

z-m-23-06.s.s2.r.c: x = 1 waa xal, laakiin xalka keliya ee odhaahda hadhay kadib qaybinta, 3 = x + 4, waa −1.

z-m-23-04.title: Jadwal qiimayaal miyuu go'aamin karaa xalalka tirada dhan ee f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.topic: Go'aaminta xalalka tirada dhan ee dhimbiil laba-darajo ah adigoo isticmaalaya jadwal qiimayaal iyo calaamadda shaqada laba-darajada ah
z-m-23-04.goal: Ka xukun xalka dhimbiilka laba-darajada ah isbeddelada calaamadda ee jadwalka qiimayaasha shaqada, kala sooc sheegashooyinka aan jadwalka keligiis laga samayn karin, oo sharax shuruudaha go'aamiya gabagabada.
z-m-23-04.material:
Shaqada f(x) = ax² + bx + c waa shaqo laba-darajo ah oo isku-dhufashada x² a ay togan tahay, laakiin ma ognin qiimayaasha a, b, c. Waxa keliya ee aan ognahay waa jadwalka qiimayaasha hoose, x oo dhan ee jadwalka waa tirooyin dhan.
x: −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, −1, −3, −3, −1, 3
Su'aal: Tirooyinka dhan ee x kee ayaa buuxiya f(x) < 0? (Jadwalka, safka sare waa x safka hoose-na waa qiimaha f(x), tirooyinka isla meel ku jira waa lammaane.)
z-m-23-04.thinking.1: Kala saarista sheegashooyinka aan jadwalka laga samayn karin
z-m-23-04.prereq.1: Qaabka garaafka shaqada laba-darajada ah (calaamadda a iyo jihada ay furmayso)

z-m-23-04.s.s1.prompt: Marka jadwalka oo keliya la isticmaalo oo odhaahda aan la helin, bayaankee ayaa la go'aamin karaa ee ku saabsan tirooyinka dhan x ee buuxiya f(x) < 0?
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.0: Jadwalka, calaamadee x kee u dhexeysa ayaa f ka beddelo togan una beddelo taban iyo taban una beddelo togan.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir qaabka shaqada laba-darajada ah ee a > 0, ka fikir imisa kala dhexaad ayay x-ka qiimayaasha ka yar 0 leeyihiin sameeyaan, oo barbar dhig tirooyinka dhan ee jadwalka ka baxsan.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.a: Labada keliya, 1 iyo 2. Waa meesha qiimuhu ugu yar yahay jadwalka
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.a: Xukunkani wuxuu eegayaa meesha qiimuhu ugu yar yahay oo keliya. f(x) < 0 macnaheedu waa x oo dhan oo qiimayaasha ka yar 0 leh.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.b: Lixda tiro ee dhan ee jadwalka oo dhan, laga bilaabo −1 ilaa 4
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu u arkaa x oo dhan ee jadwalka xalal. Mar kale hubi haddii tiirka qiimihiisu yahay 3 uu buuxinayo f(x) < 0.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.c: 0, 1, 2, 3, tirooyinka dhan ee jadwalka ka baxsanna ma aha xalal
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.c: Xukunkani wuxuu isticmaalayaa isbeddelada calaamadda ee jadwalka iyo qaabka shaqada laba-darajada ah labadaba.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.o.d: Qiimayaashu waxay noqon karaan taban sidoo kale tirooyinka dhan ee jadwalka ka baxsan, sidaas darteed lama go'aamin karo
z-m-23-04.s.s1.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu leeyahay qiimayaasha jadwalka ku jirin lama garanayo. Ka fikir waxa shuruudaha ah inay tahay shaqo laba-darajo ah iyo a > 0 kuu sheegayaan jadwalka dibaddiisa.
z-m-23-04.s.s1.explain: f(−1) = 3 > 0 iyo f(0) = −1 < 0, sidaas darteed calaamaddu waxay isbeddelaysaa −1 iyo 0 dhexdooda, f(3) = −1 < 0 iyo f(4) = 3 > 0, sidaas darteed waxay isbeddelaysaa 3 iyo 4 dhexdooda. Shaqo laba-darajo ah oo a > 0, x-ka f(x) < 0 waxay sameeyaan hal kala dhexaad, sidaas darteed xalku waa gudaha labadaas qodob, tirooyinka dhanna waa 0, 1, 2, 3. (Haddii aad hesho odhaahda f(x) = x² − 3x − 1 oo aad hubiso, waxaad heli doontaa isla gabagabo.)
z-m-23-04.s.s2.prompt: Arday ayaa sidan hoose uga sababeeyay jadwalka kore. Dooro sadarka khaldan, sheegashada aan jadwalka keligiis laga samayn karin.
z-m-23-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kala sooc haddii sadar kastaa wax ka sheegayo qiimayaasha jadwalka ku qoran oo keliya mise wax ka sheegayo qiimayaasha x ee jadwalka ku jirin.
